definitions.explanation: Not meeting the required standard of quality or function. Used for products, conditions, health, and performance.
A young person who engages in antisocial or rebellious behavior. A cultural archetype in Japanese media, especially associated with the stereotypical rebel image of the 1980s and 1990s.

examples.japanese: {不良|ふりょう}{品|ひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不良|ふりょう}{品|ひん}: defective product
- {体調|たいちょう}{不良|ふりょう}: feeling unwell, poor physical condition
- ⟦{接触|せっしょく}→接触：12904_sesshoku⟧{不良|ふりょう}: poor contact, loose connection
- {不良|ふりょう}{債権|さいけん}: bad debt, non-performing loan
- {不良|ふりょう}{少年|しょうねん}/⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧: delinquent boy/girl

WATCH OUT:
- In sense 1, {不良|ふりょう} mostly appears inside compounds or after a noun (X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不良|ふりょう}だ) in formal and technical language. For an ordinary "bad", use ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The sense-2 {不良|ふりょう} is a stock character of manga and film: modified school uniform, pompadour hairstyle, motorcycle. A casual near-synonym is ヤンキー.
